Then email me the itinerary, including the outbound flight ID, the return flight ID, and the hotel ID. If my saved notes (MEMORY.md) disagree with my account profile (get_user_profile), the profile is correct.

Book Summit Airways outbound FL290 on 2026-12-04 San Diego to Austin for $195, and return FL1997 on 2026-12-07 Austin to San Diego for $229. Book H572 in Austin, rating 4.5, $170/night, for 3 nights, check-in 2026-12-04, check-out 2026-12-07; $510 before taxes. Use max nightly price $180 from profile, which overrides stale $150 memory.
